text.p: - There is nothing new for the intelligence services in former presidential bodyguard Korzhakov's compromising materials about top officials, a former Moscow security chief is quoted as saying.
- Reserve general Alexander Lebed blasts Defence Minister Igor Rodionov's common sense, critisising the minister's decision to cut airborne forces.
- Alexander Lebed is planning a mutiny, Interior Minister Anatoly Kulikov says.
- President Alexander Lukashenko has promised President Boris Yeltsin that there won't be dictatorship in Belarus.
- The struggle for political influence in the armed forces is approaching a climax. Russia's chief military commander, President Boris Yeltsin, will announce his decision.
- A threat that control could be lost over safety levels at Russia's nuclear power stations might emerge for some period of time, the atomic energy minister is quoted as saying.
- The tough pressure of government credit policy and its fight against inflation are forcing industial producers to avoid bank services for payments which have resulted in huge budget loses.
- Western mass media is more and more often calling Alezander Lebed the "modern Yeltsin" and treating him as the most promising and advanced leader towards Western interests.
